name: Pocket Explorer
subtitle: Curiosity becomes a collection
description:
Turn everyday curiosity into discoveries you can keep.

Pocket Explorer helps families explore the real world together. Ask about something you notice, listen to an explanation, and collect an illustrated card that remembers the discovery.

ASK, LOOK AND LISTEN
Type a question, speak, or add a photo. Your guide gives short explanations suited to the selected age and language. Daily prepared questions offer a starting point when you want an idea.

BUILD A COLLECTION
Return for a recall question, learn from the explanation and unlock a discovery card. Follow a subject further to add new understanding and evolve your collection.

REMEMBER WHERE IT HAPPENED
Add a place to a discovery and revisit adventures on your map. Explore participating events and shared discoveries when available nearby.

MAKE A LITTLE MEMORY
Revisit your questions and observations as a story. Share a selected adventure by link so family and friends can view it in their browser.

EXPLORE WITH PEOPLE YOU KNOW
With family permissions enabled, connect using friend codes, exchange cards and send text messages. Reporting and blocking are available in conversations.

MADE FOR SHARED FAMILY USE
A grown-up can choose permissions, explanation style and a daily time limit. Choose English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese or Arabic.

Live AI, new illustrations and online sharing need an internet connection. AI can make mistakes. A grown-up should check uncertain answers and accompany real-world exploration. Event availability varies by location.
promotionalText: Ask about the world around you. Collect discoveries, revisit little adventures and share a story with your family.
reviewNotes:
Pocket Explorer is free, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions or advertising. This version retains public discovery browsing, friend codes, card exchange and text chat, as declared in the age questionnaire. It is not submitted to the Kids Category and does not implement age assurance. Family PIN protection does not verify adulthood or guardianship.

No existing login is required. On first launch, choose a language. Chat, Map and Social are the main tabs, and Home remains available from detail screens. Prepared discoveries and the sample journal can be browsed before granting cloud AI permission.

To test live AI: open the profile avatar, then Family settings. Create settings with any six-digit PIN and save the displayed recovery code. Unlock settings and open Cloud AI data use. Review the disclosure and tap Allow cloud AI data use. Return to Chat and type a new question. Question answering, image generation and narration use Microsoft Azure AI services through our Cloudflare backend. Cloudflare also processes eligible question text for semantic answer reuse.

Keep a discovery, answer its recall question correctly and open the resulting card. Wrong answers explain the correct answer and allow retry. New illustration generation is asynchronous, with bounded waiting and retry controls. Prepared illustrations may appear immediately. Map includes memories, events and shared discoveries. Event visits depend on location and active event dates.

To withdraw AI permission, return to Cloud AI data use in Family settings. Withdrawal blocks new live AI requests locally and syncs when online. Prepared content stays available. Camera, microphone and location are optional. Speech recognition requires on-device support, and typing remains available if permission is denied or local recognition is unavailable.

Account deletion is in Family settings. Unlock with the chosen PIN, select Delete account and data, and confirm. This removes associated server data and revokes public links. When deletion finishes, close and reopen the app to initialize a fresh journal. Interrupted deletion can be retried. The website has a separate account and its own deletion control.

Friends and public sharing are controlled through Family settings. Social supports report and block. The support contact and privacy notice are available in the app and at https://pocket.changhai.me/support/ and https://pocket.changhai.me/privacy/.
